components.name: measurement
components.reason: Exact seven-line Sirius production fit scatter 0.130 dex divided by sqrt(7); transition/systematic terms remain separate.

components.name: transition_data
components.reason: Adopted fully correlated common-source gf scale, 0.097 dex per line, from Garz 1973/O’Brian & Lawler 1991; not divided by sqrt(7).

components.name: stellar.teff
components.reason: Sirius exact seven-line paired synthesis response, adopted solar Teff uncertainty 1 K.

components.name: stellar.logg
components.reason: Sirius exact seven-line paired synthesis response at logg 4.34/4.54; adopted 0.10 dex solar logg allowance.

components.name: stellar.xi
components.reason: Sirius exact seven-line paired synthesis response, adopted xi allowance 0.2912 km/s.

components.name: stellar.metallicity
components.reason: Sirius exact seven-line paired synthesis response at [Fe/H] -0.10/+0.10; adopted 0.05 dex solar metallicity allowance.

components.name: continuum
components.reason: No independent sideband continuum perturbation remains after assigning local-renormalization response to pseudo_continuum.

components.name: profile_ew
components.reason: Sirius exact seven-line half-width 0.40 A perturbation; candidate response 0.005 dex.

components.name: pseudo_continuum
components.reason: Sirius exact seven-line local-renormalization response used as pseudo-continuum sensitivity.

components.name: telluric
components.reason: Sirius exact seven-line native versus molecfit-corrected HARPS abundance response; mean delta 0.001 dex.

components.name: holding_instrument
components.reason: Empirical HARPS/IAG/KPNO random-instrument-intercept spread across exact seven-line means; 0.0355 dex systematic, not divided by sqrt(3).

components.name: blends
components.reason: Sirius exact seven-line blend-on/off response; mean absolute response 0.00914 dex.

note: Partial quadrature is diagnostic only; no total is published while required HOLD components remain.
